interface.longDescription: Choose tools for music analysis and lyric timing, beat-synchronised video, live web motion, image analysis and keyword research. DanceFlow routes tasks to independently maintained components through local MCP tools and guided skills. Configure a local workspace and each required runtime; catalogue access alone does not run every engine. Potbot and Unity entries are source-preview references with native-host requirements and no execution adapters. Browser and WordPress tasks need their documented hosts. Website: https://kieransimkin.co.uk/danceflow/
defaultPrompt: Analyse my song's tempo and structure, keeping estimates separate from verified timing.
Render a beat-synchronised lyric video from my audio, LRC lyrics and cue file.
Make web effects follow an audio player's clock, with reduced-motion support.
